causes.label: Dryer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure the dryer plug is pushed completely into the outlet.

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped
remedies: Check the house fuse/circuit breaker box and replace fuse or reset breaker.
NOTE: Most electric dryers use two fuses/breakers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat
remedies: Check the house fuse/circuit breaker box and replace both fuses or reset both breakers.
Your dryer may tumble if only one fuse is blown or one breaker is tripped.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat"

causes.label: Gas service is off
remedies: Make sure gas shutoff at dryer and main shutoff are fully open.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Gas service is off"

causes.label: No heat temperature selected
remedies: Select another heat setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "No heat temperature selected"

causes.label: Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly
remedies: Move dryer to an even floor space, or adjust leveling legs as necessary until even.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly"

causes.label: Improper use of fabric softener
remedies: Follow directions on fabric softener package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Improper use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Drying dirty items with clean ones
remedies: Use your dryer to dry only clean items.
Dirty items can stain clean items and the dryer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Drying dirty items with clean ones"

causes.label: Clothes were not completely clean
remedies: Sometimes stains which cannot be seen when the clothes are wet appear after drying.
Use proper washing procedures before drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Clothes were not completely clean"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint screen before each load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Sort lint producers (like chenille) from lint collectors (like corduroy).

causes.label: Static electricity can attract lint
remedies: See suggestions in this section under STATIC.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Static electricity can attract lint"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.

causes.label: Paper, tissue, etc., left in pockets
remedies: Empty all pockets before laundering clothes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Paper, tissue, etc., left in pockets"

causes.label: No fabric softener was used
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Bounce® Fabric Conditioner Dryer Sheets have been approved for use in all GE Dryers when used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "No fabric softener was used"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Adjust setting to LESS DRY or DAMP DRY.

causes.label: Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static"

causes.label: Type of heat
remedies: Automatic drying times will vary according to the type of heat used (electric, natural or LP gas), size of load, types of fabrics, wetness of clothes and condition of exhaust ducts.
